interview_meta.target_role: Full-Stack Web Development Intern (React + Node / Python)

recommendations: Validate hands-on depth in core strengths: JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js.
Conduct deep-dive on flagship project: 'Collaborative Real-Time Whiteboard & Code Editor'.
Inquire how candidate's unique skills (Socket.io, Unit Testing) can add cross-disciplinary value.

technical_questions.question: Can you compare Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) with alternative approaches, detailing the specific performance and maintainability trade-offs?
technical_questions.rationale: Tests deep mastery of 'JavaScript' matching core JD requirements and candidate's stated skill set.
technical_questions.rubric_5_scale: Candidate articulates Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) fundamentals, discusses Preflight OPTIONS requests and Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers, and recognizes production constraints.
technical_questions.follow_up_probe: If you had to scale or optimize Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) under 10x traffic volume, what would be your first engineering step?

technical_questions.question: What key best practices and metrics should an engineering team monitor when deploying features utilizing WebSockets vs Server-Sent Events (SSE)?
technical_questions.rationale: Tests deep mastery of 'TypeScript' matching core JD requirements and candidate's stated skill set.
technical_questions.rubric_5_scale: Candidate articulates WebSockets vs Server-Sent Events (SSE) fundamentals, discusses Bi-directional full duplex and Uni-directional streaming, and recognizes production constraints.
technical_questions.follow_up_probe: If you had to scale or optimize WebSockets vs Server-Sent Events (SSE) under 10x traffic volume, what would be your first engineering step?

technical_questions.question: In a high-scale production system, what common pitfalls arise when implementing React Hooks & Memory Leaks, and how do you mitigate them?
technical_questions.rationale: Tests deep mastery of 'React.js' matching core JD requirements and candidate's stated skill set.
expected_answer_points: Mastery of useRef for mutable references
technical_questions.rubric_5_scale: Candidate articulates React Hooks & Memory Leaks fundamentals, discusses useEffect cleanup functions and useRef for mutable references, and recognizes production constraints.
technical_questions.follow_up_probe: If you had to scale or optimize React Hooks & Memory Leaks under 10x traffic volume, what would be your first engineering step?

technical_questions.question: Can you compare Database Normalization vs Denormalization with alternative approaches, detailing the specific performance and maintainability trade-offs?
technical_questions.rationale: Tests deep mastery of 'Node.js' matching core JD requirements and candidate's stated skill set.
expected_answer_points: Mastery of Read vs Write performance
technical_questions.rubric_5_scale: Candidate articulates Database Normalization vs Denormalization fundamentals, discusses 1NF, 2NF, 3NF forms and Read vs Write performance, and recognizes production constraints.
technical_questions.follow_up_probe: If you had to scale or optimize Database Normalization vs Denormalization under 10x traffic volume, what would be your first engineering step?

technical_questions.question: Can you compare Server-Side Rendering (SSR) vs Hydration with alternative approaches, detailing the specific performance and maintainability trade-offs?

technical_questions.rubric_5_scale: Candidate articulates Server-Side Rendering (SSR) vs Hydration fundamentals, discusses HTML streaming and Client hydration errors, and recognizes production constraints.

coding_scenario.title: Full-Stack Web Development Live Practical Scenario
coding_scenario.scenario: Suppose a user reports that a critical service in your Full-Stack Web Development stack is experiencing intermittent 504 gateway timeouts under peak morning traffic. Walk through your step-by-step diagnostic workflow, telemetry inspection, and remediation strategy.
evaluation_criteria: Checks logs, metrics (CPU, RAM, DB connections), and error traces
Reproduces issue with isolated test case or query profiler
Proposes short-term mitigation (scaling/caching) and long-term architectural fix
